name: flex_kernels_v1
label: Polynomial, spherical-harmonic, and Fourier mixture kernels on frozen PRH layers
nu_construction: 10 ** linspace(-1, log10(8), 12); last entry snapped to 8
s_ref_note: Frozen from previous experiment typical train median distances (~0.82–1.05). Canonical profile comparison only.

families.monomial: w_p t^p, p=1..P, simplex, linear is p=1
families.spherical: shared harmonic-order weights on Z_{p,d_A} and Z_{p,d_B}
families.sph_fourier: spherical p=1..P plus 12 spectral shells; linear is p=1 once

penalty: R = lam_nl*(1-c_lin) + lam_complexity*(poly_degree_cost + fourier_freq_cost) + lam_smooth*sum (Delta c_fourier)^2. Polynomial families omit Fourier terms. lin_fourier omits poly degree cost.
objective_scaling: maximize J(c)/J(linear) - R(c) on train; skip fit if J(linear)<=1e-8
reg_selection: per pair, per family, per objective: argmax unpenalised validation J
family_choice: report each family separately; optional val-mean ranking is not used to drop families from eval
hyp0f1: power series for |z|<80; Gaussian high-d limit exp(-nu^2 r^2 / 2) otherwise; record fallback fraction
